tools.name: search_breeds
tools.description: Use when someone is choosing a dog breed or asks which breeds are healthy, e.g. 'healthiest small dog breeds' or 'welche Rasse passt zu mir'. Searches HonestDog's breed catalogue by name (German or English, umlauts optional), size class, or S–E breeding-health grade, most popular first. Returns breed slugs for the other tools, a breed photo, and the honestdog.de breed page URL. / Durchsucht den HonestDog-Rassenkatalog nach Name, Größe oder S–E-Gesundheitsnote.

query.description: Breed name or part of it, in German or English, umlauts optional — e.g. 'pudel', 'german shepherd', 'schaeferhund'

size.description: Size class filter. Breeds are recorded as small/medium/large (toy and giant currently match nothing)

health_grade.description: HonestDog S–E health grade (S = healthiest breeding basis)

tools.name: get_breed_health_profile
tools.description: Use when someone asks how healthy a breed is, which hereditary diseases it has, or which health tests to ask a breeder for (e.g. 'Labrador hip dysplasia tests', 'Französische Bulldogge gesund?'). HonestDog's proprietary per-breed health data: the S–E breeding-health grade with rationale, hereditary diseases, and the health tests breeders should run — L1 = the breed's core standard: required by the breed club's Zuchtordnung where `club_required` is true (club and document named), otherwise HonestDog's recommended standard. Where HonestDog has an explainer, `qualzucht_traits` lists the breed's extreme-breeding (Qualzucht) traits with their level — a listed trait does not mean every dog of the breed is affected. / HonestDogs Gesundheitsprofil je Rasse: S–E-Note, Erbkrankheiten und die wichtigsten Gesundheitstests (Pflicht laut Zuchtordnung, wo der Verein sie vorschreibt, sonst empfohlener Standard).

breed_slug.description: Breed slug as returned by search_breeds, e.g. 'zwergpudel'

tools.name: search_breeders
tools.description: Use when someone wants to buy a puppy from a reputable breeder, e.g. 'find a Labrador breeder in Bavaria' or 'seriöser Züchter Golden Retriever Bayern'. Searches HonestDog's directory of vetted, APPROVED dog breeders — mostly in Germany and Austria, with some in other European countries (each result names its country). Filter by breed (slug from search_breeds; exact breed only — breeders of crosses such as Labradoodle are not listed under a parent breed), region (state in the breeder's country, German spelling, e.g. 'Bayern', 'Steiermark') or city. Returns kennel name, photo, city/region/country, HonestDog score and the honestdog.de profile URL — contact happens there, never through this tool. For Qualzucht breeds this returns a caution instead of results. / Für 'Welpen vom seriösen Züchter kaufen': durchsucht das Verzeichnis geprüfter Züchter (nur freigegebene Profile, öffentliche Daten; Ort nur als Stadt/Region/Land).

breed_slug.description: Restrict to breeders of this breed (slug from search_breeds)

state.description: Region in the breeder's country, German spelling — a German or Austrian Bundesland such as 'Bayern' or 'Steiermark' (English names like 'Bavaria' are mapped)

tools.name: search_shelter_dogs
tools.description: Use when someone wants to adopt a dog from a shelter in Germany, e.g. 'adopt a dog in Berlin' or 'Hund aus dem Tierheim adoptieren Bayern'. Searches dogs currently listed for adoption by German partner shelters on HonestDog (coverage is still small — a few shelters, mostly mixed breeds), by breed (German or English), size, gender, or Bundesland. Returns name, photos (only where the shelter consented), age in years, size, shelter and the honestdog.de listing URL; adoption happens with the shelter via the linked pages. / Durchsucht die aktuell zur Adoption gelisteten Tierheimhunde nach Rasse, Größe, Geschlecht oder Bundesland.

breed_text.description: Breed in German or English, umlauts optional (e.g. 'Schäferhund', 'german shepherd', 'Mischling'); matched against the shelter's breed text and HonestDog's breed catalogue

size.description: Size class (shelters list sizes in German; mapped server-side)

state.description: German Bundesland of the shelter, e.g. 'Nordrhein-Westfalen' (English names like 'North Rhine-Westphalia' are mapped)

tools.name: about_honestdog
tools.description: What HonestDog is, where its breeder, shelter and breed-health data comes from, and how results link back to honestdog.de. Use when the user asks what HonestDog is or whether its data can be trusted. / Was HonestDog ist, woher die Daten stammen und wie Ergebnisse auf honestdog.de verweisen.
